abilities.name: Archangel's Wrath
abilities.description: Upon dying, become Invulnerable and gain 20% Movement Speed for 4 seconds. Upon expiration, explode, dealing 450 damage and reducing Tyrael's death timer by 10% per enemy Hero hit. Archangel's Wrath reduces nearby enemy Heroes' damage by 50% while active and for 3 seconds after it expires.; trait

fields.type: Spell Damage / Offensive damage modifier / Special death state, Status effect
fields.notes: Tyrael ignores collision until he explodes. During Archangel's Wrath, Tyrael can move through pathing blockers and enemy Gates, but not through other unpassable terrain. Damage debuff is removed immediately when the target leaves the radius of Archangel's Wrath. Duration extension requires being hit by the explosion upon expiration. Damage debuff stacks additively with other offensive damage modifiers affecting the target Hero's damage output.

abilities.name: El'druin's Might
abilities.description: Throw El'druin to the target area, dealing 110 damage to nearby enemies and Slowing them by 30% for 2.5 seconds. Reactivate within 5 seconds to teleport Tyrael to El'druin and Slow nearby enemies again.; 12 / 0.5

fields.type: Spell Damage, Crowd control / Movement: Teleport
fields.notes: El'druin's Might cannot be cast on unpathable terrain. Teleport on secondary cast has no range limit. Reactivation has an initial 0.5 second cooldown, and it cannot be used before the thrown sword has reached the target location. All reactivations of El'druin's Might are considered Basic Ability casts. Cooldown starts when the Ability is activated for the first time.

abilities.name: Righteousness
abilities.description: Shields Tyrael for 350 damage and nearby allies for 40% as much for 4 seconds.

fields.notes: Damage dealt to allies shielded by Righteousness is shown in small pop-up numbers. Regardless of the real damage type of the attack, these numbers appear in orange, normally reserved for Physical Damage.

abilities.name: Smite
abilities.description: Rake target area for 150 damage. For the next 3 seconds, allies moving through the targeted area gain 25% Movement Speed for 2 seconds.

fields.notes: 1) Area consists of 5 overlapping circles with 1.5 radius in a wide V-shape. The ground effect lingers for 3 seconds, applying the buff to allies in the area every 0.25 seconds. Multiple instances of the buff only refresh the duration.

abilities.name: Judgment
abilities.description: After 0.75 seconds, charge an enemy Hero, dealing 150 damage and Stunning them for 1.5 seconds. Nearby enemies are knocked away and take 75 damage.; 70; 80; heroic

fields.type: Spell Damage, Crowd control / Movement: Launch, Status effect
fields.props: Area of Effect, Channeled cast (stationary), Knockback, Splash, Stun, Unstoppable
fields.notes: Interrupting Tyrael during the cast puts the Ability on a 10-second cooldown. Upon activation Tyrael gains vision of the target for the duration of the Ability. The cast is also interrupted if the target becomes untargetable, gains Stealth or moves farther than 5 units past its maximum cast range during the windup. Charging Tyrael can only be disjointed if the target dies, is removed from the plane (certain Stasis effects) or instantly teleports farther than 20 units from its previous location. When disjointed, the charge expires upon reaching the target's location before the event. Otherwise, the charge will keep redirecting to the target unit. Judgment always applies its area effects upon reaching the end location, regardless of being able to hit its original target. Tyrael is Unstoppable while charging.

abilities.name: Sanctification
abilities.description: After 0.5 seconds create a field of holy energy that makes allied Heroes Invulnerable. Lasts 3 seconds.; 90; 75; heroic

fields.props: Area of Effect, Channeled cast (stationary), Invulnerable
fields.notes: Interrupting Sanctification during its cast puts the Ability on a 10-second cooldown.

talents.name: Salvation
talents.description: Increase the Shield amount Tyrael gains from Righteousness by 35% and heal Tyrael for 150 Health if his Shield is destroyed. Does not increase the Shield amount gained by allies.

fields.notes: Healing does not trigger if the Shield expires without breaking.

talents.name: Ardent Restoration
talents.description: Dealing damage to a Hero heals Tyrael for 20 over 5 seconds. Dealing damage resets this timer, and the heal amount stacks up to 10 times. Questonly Every Regeneration Globe gathered increases this heal amount by 1%.

fields.notes: Quest healing bonus stacks additively with healing dealt modifiers that can affect healing from Ardent Restoration.

talents.description: Gain 25 Armor while El'druin's Might is active, and for 3 seconds after teleporting.

fields.notes: Does not stack with itself or other positive Armor effects. Other defensive damage modifiers may stack.

talents.description: When Tyrael's Shield from Righteousness expires or is destroyed, it deals 190 damage to nearby Heroes and Summons. For each enemy Hero damaged by Reciprocate or El'druin's Might, Tyrael heals for 3% of his maximum Health.

talents.name: Burning Halo
talents.description: Both Tyrael and El'druin deal 15 damage per second to nearby enemies. Teleporting increases this damage from Tyrael by 125% for 2 seconds.

fields.notes: 1) Extended by Tyrael's unit radius. Enemies can take damage from both Tyrael's and El'druin's damage auras at the same time. When Sword of Justice is picked, the first reactivation increases the damage around both Tyrael and El'druin. The second reactivation does not further increase the damage, but only reapplies or refreshes the effect. Does not affect unaggroed neutral Mercenaries. Does not draw tower aggro when damaging enemy Heroes under their Structures. Damage from Burning Halo is unaffected by external offensive damage modifiers and lifesteal effects. Disabled while Mounted, Stealthed or in Stasis.

_raw_fields: Both Tyrael and El'druin deal 15 damage per second to nearby enemies. Teleporting increases this damage from Tyrael by 125% for 2 seconds.

fields.notes: Subsequent applications refresh the duration. Stacks from previous casts carry over. Damage bonus stacks additively with itself and other offensive damage modifiers that can affect Tyrael's Basic Attack damage.

fields.notes: Does not stack with itself. Subsequent applications refresh the duration. Movement Speed bonus stacks additively with baseline bonus, but not with other sources of Movement Speed. Attack Speed stacks additively with other effects that can affect the target's Attack Speed.
